body:
'Who want's to roll tonite,' says my long time buddy M. I roll a fairly decent amount, say 2 - 5 times a month. I decided to get a little bold and down 5 double stacked red ferrari's which I was told were close to pure MDMA... But you now how that goes...
Time: + 1 hour --> 3 pills
Definitly starting to feel it. My voice sounds raspy and my breathing get's really really deep and I decide to take my next 2 pills at this moment thinking it's going to increase my roll a lot...
Time + 1:30 --> 2 pills
Wow, My eyes have never twitched like this before. My vision is so blurry I can't even make a phone call cuz I can't see where the phone is. My muscles are beginning to get pretty tight now too.... Suddenly.... I get hit. SMASH, and wave of... I don't even know ... But it was defintly a wave. It almost felt being drunk, but not the physical part. But again, it seemed to have a little feeling of mdma.
Time + 2:30 -->
Pure hallucinations. I'm standing in a bathroom looking at a mirror, except the mirror was an ocean, that's right an ocean, and in this ocean, what do I see? Obviously a bite sized blue dolphin. And logically, this blue dolphin, after swimming within an inch of my house turned into a coffee cup...
Time + 3:30 -->
Hmm... Thought I was coming down, but I was probably just hallucinating that. For the next 2 hours I was lying down in a bed being hit with mind blowing hallucinations ranging from objects puffing into smoke, objects turning into a wire mesh and somehow spontaneously moving inches from my face, I could then break the wire mesh and mold the object, while actually feeling these hallucinations.
Time + 5:30 -->
Most amazing drug experience of my life, by a long shot. The body high was pretty damn good, but it was a mind blower, I thought I could've taken some really rare pills with acid in em, but def. Not, not the same thing as lsd, not even close. Every hallucination, from devil's to dolphins were happy-go-lucky, and innocent.
